notes.title: PATCH D.3 IS OUT!
notes.notes:
* Optional Boss Fight now has its own OST!
* New animation for Dart's run
* Controller support! Use Settings -> Controller to see the controller map or simply pay attention to glyphs shown in the tutorial and rest of the UI
* Fixed an issue which would cause a crash on devices and driver versions which do not support triple buffering
* Minor wording fixes in ability descriptions
